backend-engineer.description: Full-stack Supabase backend specialist: DB schema, RLS policies, RPC functions, triggers, supabase-js queries, and server component data fetching.

frontend-engineer.description: Next.js App Router + Tailwind UI specialist: server/client components, optimistic mutations, routing, SEO metadata, and the zinc-quiet design system.

db-reviewer.description: Reviews schema and RLS changes for security, policy gaps, and phase-block conventions in supabase-schema.sql.

lint.template: Run `npm run lint` and fix any errors or warnings it reports. Re-run until clean.

typecheck.description: Run the TypeScript compiler in strict no-emit mode per the contributing desk check.
typecheck.template: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` from the repo root and fix every type error it reports. TypeScript must stay strict: no new `any` unless a Supabase join forces a narrow `unknown` cast. Re-run until clean.

phase.description: Summarize the current active phase and what needs to be implemented next from PLANNING.md.
phase.template: Read PLANNING.md. Identify the current active phase and its unique delivery steps. Summarize what is done and what the next concrete implementation step should be, then propose how to proceed.

deskcheck.description: Walk through the full contributor desk check: typecheck, routes tour, and schema stamp reminder.
deskcheck.template: Run the Step 9 desk check from CONTRIBUTING.md: run `npx tsc --noEmit`, then audit the routes /, /write, /dashboard, /settings, /search, /notifications, /bookmarks. Report what passes and what fails, and remind about the Schema Stamp for any phase block touched.
